name: Kyunki... Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi...
description: A mother-in-law's struggle to put up with her three bahu's. The three bahu's have grown up sons. The bahu's sons start to get involved with having girlfriends and the bahu's try and break their relationships up.

videos.title: Amba Gets Disappointed
videos.overview: As the Viranis forget Amba's birthday the latter gets disappointed. Later, Amba is delighted to learn from Tulsi about Mihir's gift for her birthday.

videos.title: Amba's Desire for her Birthday
videos.overview: Amba makes a wish to have dinner with her family members on her birthday. Later, during the dinner, Daksha and Gayatri make a scene and a conflict ensues.

videos.title: Mihir Returns from America
videos.overview: Govardhan consoles Amba and tells her to accept the ignorance of the family members. Meanwhile, Mihir returns from America and surprises Amba and Govardhan.

videos.title: Mihir Convinces Savita
videos.overview: Mihir tries to convince Savita when the latter gets angry at him for giving more importance to Amba rather than her. Later, Savita tells Govardhan not to interfere in her decision about Mihir.

videos.title: Mihir Confronts Tulsi
videos.overview: Mihir confronts Tulsi for the first time in the temple. Later, when Mihir visit Niharika's house with a marriage proposal the latter requests him to reject her.

videos.title: Mihir Lies to Niharika's Parents
videos.overview: Vasantlal furiously asks Mihir to leave the house when the latter lies to them to keep Niharika's request. Later, Savita insults Amba for sewing clothes for others.

videos.title: Govardhan's Stand for Amba
videos.overview: Govardhan tells Savita, Daksha, and Gayatri to respect Amba as their own mother. Later, Amba decides to invite Payal's parents to talk about Mihir and Payal's marriage.

videos.title: Payal Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Amba praises Tulsi as she knows that the latter prepares the food instead of Payel. Elsewhere, Payal gets jealous and decides to show Tulsi her actual status.

videos.title: Mihir Gets Furious
videos.overview: Mihir furiously lashes out at Payal when he learns about Payal's lie to skip Sejal's dance show. Meanwhile, Payal tries to impress Savita, Gayatri and Daksha.

videos.title: Payal Insults Tulsi
videos.overview: Payal invites Tulsi to her house to apply Mehendi in her hand. Later, Tulsi gives a stern reply when Payal tries to insult her in front of her friends.

videos.title: Hemant Convinces Tulsi
videos.overview: Hemant gets infuriated to learn about Payal's behaviour towards Tulsi and convinces her to attend the engagement. Later, Govardhan tries to console Amba.

videos.title: Payal's Wicked Plan
videos.overview: Mihir gets to learn about Payal's behaviour towards Tulsi from Hemant and Sejal's conversation. Later, Payal makes a wicked plan to break Mihir and Tulsi's friendship.

videos.title: Chirag Attempts Suicide
videos.overview: Payal tries to instigate Savita against Amba and Govardhan. Meanwhile, the Police rescue Chirag when he tries to commit suicide and bring him back to Virani's house.

videos.title: Payal Makes Mihir Furious
videos.overview: Mihir furiously lashes out at Payal after learning about her lie. Meanwhile, Mihir accidentally reveals that it would be better if he marries Tulsi rather than Payal.

videos.title: Savita Asks Tulsi to Stay Away
videos.overview: Mihir complains about Payal to Amba and Tulsi asks Mihir to apologise to Payal. Later, Savita thinks that Tulsi is the one creating an issue and asks her to stay away.

videos.title: Tulsi's Dad Has a Heart Attack
videos.overview: Payal and her mother plot against the Viranis which results in Tulsi's father suffering a heart attack. Later, Mihir invites Payal and her mother for dinner.

videos.title: Payal Dissolves the Engagement
videos.overview: A furious Payal breaks off the engagement when Mihir compares her to Tulsi. Later, Hemant, Chirag and Suhasi help Mihir and Tulsi in realizing their love for each other.

videos.title: Mihir Faces a Tough Decision
videos.overview: Payal's mother apologises to Tulsi and asks her to convince Mihir to marry Payal. Meanwhile, Mihir accepts his feelings for Tulsi and Amba asks him to express his love.

videos.title: Tulsi, Mihir Accept Their Feelings
videos.overview: Mihir expresses his love to Tulsi and explains why he is rejecting Payal. Realizing that she has feelings for Mihir, Tulsi confesses to Mihir when he visits her.

videos.title: Mihir, Tulsi to Get Married!
videos.overview: Payal�s parents meet Savita and Mansukh to convince them to go ahead with Mihir and Payal�s marriage. Later, Mihir and Tulsi get married with Tulsi�s father's blessings.

videos.title: Mihir Marries Tulsi
videos.overview: While Mihir gets married to Tulsi at the temple, Savita makes preparations for Payal. Later, Mihir brings Tulsi home but Savita refuses to accept her as a daughter-in-law.

videos.title: Savita Secludes Herself
videos.overview: Mihir apologizes to Savita for being hasty but she secludes herself from all the family members. Later, Savita insults Tulsi�s father due to which Amba apologizes to him.

videos.title: Mihir, Tulsi's Honeymoon!
videos.overview: Daksha informs Savita that Mihir and Tulsi are going to their honeymoon and she falls sick. Later, Gayatri and Daksha manipulate Savita.

videos.title: Savita Accepts Tulsi
videos.overview: Savita listens to Daksha and agrees to accept Tulsi to stop Mihir from leaving the house. Later, Savita insults Amba and Govardhan asks Tulsi to take care of Amba.

videos.title: Tulsi Seeks Permission
videos.overview: Tulsi seeks Savita's permission to go on her honeymoon, but is forced to delay. Further, Govardhan offers Naveen a job in a textile company.

videos.title: Savita Behaves Obnoxiously
videos.overview: Savita insults Amba, Pragya and Tulsi on various occasions and gets upset when Tulsi sides with Pragya. Meanwhile, Kiran informs Tulsi about his visit to India.

videos.title: Amba Gets Blamed
videos.overview: Mihir and Hemant get a new flat for Pragya which makes Govardhan happy. Later, Amba gets rebuked for giving her jewellery to Pragya.

videos.title: Hemant Gets Attacked
videos.overview: While Mihir and Tulsi are on their honeymoon, their factory workers attack Hemant. Later, Savita asks Mihir to return immediately.

videos.title: Mihir, Tulsi Return Home
videos.overview: Mihir and Tulsi cancel their honeymoon and return home upon hearing of Hemant's condition. Meanwhile, Kiran plans a party for his brother Mihir.

videos.title: Mihir Doubts the Manager
videos.overview: Kiran and Mihir want to go to Aligarh to solve the problem brewing there. Mihir suspects the manager. Meanwhile, both Kiran and Chirag are in love!

videos.title: Savita Insults Tulsi
videos.overview: Savita insults Tulsi and her father at the party. Amba tries to comfort them, but in vain. Tulsi is hurt when Mihir does not support her.

videos.title: Kiran Finds Aarti
videos.overview: Kiran is forced to see Aarti; the girl Savita has chosen for him. Surprisingly, Aarti turns out to be Soni.

videos.title: Himmat Goes Missing
videos.overview: The Virani family is worried when Himmat doesn't return home! Later, Mihir is called to the police station to identify a dead body.

videos.title: Himmat Is Kidnapped
videos.overview: As the family worries about a missing Himmat, they receive a ransom call. Who kidnapped Himmat?

videos.title: Police Rescue Himmat
videos.overview: Himmat's kidnapping disturbs Chirag. Mihir and Jamnadas arrive at the kidnapper's hideout, and police arrest the kidnappers.

videos.title: Kiran's Wedding Preparations
videos.overview: The family is delighted to see Himmat safe. The Viranis prepare for Kiran's wedding, while Savita plots against Tulsi!

videos.title: Mihir Is Angry with Tulsi
videos.overview: Despite Mihir's disapproval, Tulsi visits Aarti's house for the Mehendi. She upsets Mihir and he gets angry with her.

videos.title: Pujari Is Invited to the Wedding
videos.overview: Savita doesn't wish to invite Pujari to the wedding. Although, Amba and Govardhan personally invited Pujari, who reluctantly accepted the invitation.

videos.title: Savita's Ploy to Defame Tulsi
videos.overview: The daughters-in-law are instructed to take care of Pujari's needs at the wedding.. Meanwhile, Savita gives the responsibility of the necklace to Tulsi.

videos.title: Tulsi's Necklace Goes Missing!
videos.overview: Tulsi is anxious and worried as Savita gives her greater responsibilities. Tulsi hands over the necklace to Amba, later the necklace goes missing!

videos.title: Daksha Stole the Necklace?
videos.overview: Tulsi tells Hemant about the missing necklace, claiming that Daksha has it. Daksha denies it and says she has a similar necklace and is upset over the family.

videos.title: Tulsi Gets Accused
videos.overview: Tulsi is suspected by Daksha and Savita of stealing the necklace. Kiran has complete faith in Tulsi, but her innocence is in jeopardy.

videos.title: The Viranis Defend Tulsi
videos.overview: Daksha and Gayatri accuse Tulsi of stealing the necklace, but the other members of the family defend Tulsi. Later, Jamnadas catches Raghu with money.

videos.title: Tulsi's Innocence is Proved
videos.overview: Jamnadas apologises to Tulsi and Mihir, revealing it was Gayatri who had stolen the necklace. Later, Daksha reveals Savita's entire plan against Tulsi.

videos.title: Tulsi Convinces Govardhan
videos.overview: Amba gets worried about the differences between Tulsi and Mihir's relationship. Meanwhile, Tulsi tries to convince Govardhan to forgive Raghu for his mistake.

videos.title: Sejal's Life is in Danger
videos.overview: When Sejal and Anand meet with an accident, Payal finds them and quickly rushes them to a hospital. Elsewhere, Savita chooses not to inform Tulsi about it.

videos.title: Payal tries to impress Mihir
videos.overview: Savita lies to Mihir about Tulsi's phone and turns him against Tulsi while Payal tries to win Mihir's heart. Later, Sejal returns home from the hospital.

videos.title: Tulsi Returns Home
videos.overview: While Govardhan is worried about the strike at the factory, Tulsi returns home to find Payal doing her duties. Later, Mihir expresses his anger towards Tulsi.

videos.title: Aarti learns the truth
videos.overview: Kiran informs Aarti that it was Gayatri who stole the necklace and not Tulsi. While Aarti wishes to join the Virani business, Anand proposes to Sejal.

videos.title: Suhasi and Rakesh get married
videos.overview: Rakesh and his family come to the Virani house to discuss his marriage to Suhasi. While JD decides not to speak to Gayatri, Daksha and Savita try to resolve the issue.

videos.title: Kiran's Secret Mission
videos.overview: Kiran goes to the Virani factory disguised as a labourer to find out what is really going on behind the Viranis' back. Elsewhere, Tulsi and Mihir share a romantic moment.

videos.title: Mihir Berates Tulsi

videos.title: Amba's Plea to Savita
videos.overview: Kiran finds out at the factory that Ramesh Yadav has complete control over it despite being in jail. Later, Amba tries to convince Savita of Tulsi's innocence.

videos.title: Kiran's Genius Plan
videos.overview: Kiran manages to get the job as the servant of the factory manager and learns about how they keep the Viranis in the dark. Later, Tulsi sees Mihir with Payal.

videos.title: Govardhan Visits the Factory
videos.overview: Kiran asks Govardhan to come to the factory with Aarti and plans to introduce her as Kiran to the workers. Elsewhere, Tulsi berates Payal for wearing her saree.

videos.title: Savita Invites Payal

videos.title: Tulsi to Apologise Payal
videos.overview: While Tulsi surprises Daksha, Gayatri, and Savita with her decision to apologise to Payal, Amba feels happy. Later, the Viranis fix Suhasis's marriage with Rakesh.

videos.title: Suhasi's Wedding Prep
videos.overview: Tulsi tries to resolve the dispute between JD and Gayatri. While the Viranis prepare for Suhanis's wedding, Kiran informs her about his absence on the occasion.

videos.title: Gayatri's Dance Practice
videos.overview: Gayatri and JD sort out the differences that came between them. Later, as Gayatri pursues her love for dancing and Tulsi asks Amba to help Gayatri fulfil her dream.

videos.title: Rakesh, Suhani Take Vows
videos.overview: When the Virani family receives Rakesh, Mihir makes fun of him. Later, Rakesh and Suhasi exchange their wedding vows and perform rituals.

videos.title: Suhasi Learns a Shocker
videos.overview: Tulsi challenges Payal to take Mihir's signature on the Divorce paper. Elsewhere, Suhasi gets shocked when Rakesh informs her about his son.

videos.title: Payal's Plot Against Tulsi
videos.overview: Payal seeks help from Deepak to bring trouble into Tulsi's life and fulfil her intention. Elsewhere, Suhasi mentions to Rakesh that she cannot accept him as her husband.

videos.title: Payal Executes Her Plan
videos.overview: Payal asks Deepak to visit Shantinikerana and ruin Tulsi's character. Later, he makes an anonymous call as Tulsi's lovers and brings doubt in the Viranis.

videos.title: Tulsi in Payal's Trap
videos.overview: Tulsi remains surprised as Rakesh calls and urges her to meet him. Later, he sends fake love letters to the Viranis exploiting them against Tulsi.

videos.title: Savita Probes Tulsi
videos.overview: Savita questions Tulsi about the calls and letters from an anonymous person. While Tulsi tries to make herself out of guilt, Amba supports her in finding the truth.

videos.title: Deepak Turns the Table
videos.overview: As Deepak comes to meet Tulsi, he encounters her as an old friend and plans to teach Payal a lesson. Elsewhere, Pooja gets surprised to see suspicious things in her room.

videos.title: Payal Rages in Fumes
videos.overview: As Payal learns about Deepak's counterattack on her, she gets infuriated and charges him. Elsewhere, Suhasi lies to Daksha about Rakesh and her relationship.

videos.title: Kiran Gets Attacked
videos.overview: Chirag gets poor marks in his academics and breaks down for disappointing his family. Elsewhere, goons attack Kiran n the industry premises.

videos.title: Chirag Leaves Shantiniketan
videos.overview: Daksha blames Hemant for rebuking Chirag as he leaves the house. Elsewhere, Chirag calls Daksha and tells him not to obstruct him in his career as he wants to be successful.

videos.title: Hemant Leaves for His Study
videos.overview: As Hemant leaves for his higher studies, the Viranis get emotional. However, he bids goodbye to Pooja and gives all his responsibility to her.

videos.title: Savita Misunderstands Tulsi
videos.overview: Savita feels isolated when Tulsi consoles Daksha as she breaks down, missing Chirag. Later, she misunderstands Tulsi and blames her for cornering her.

videos.title: Mihir Stands by Tulsi
videos.overview: Tulsi shares the tragic incident with Mihir and reveals that Savita tried to slap her. However, Mihir stands by Tulsi and confronts Savita.

videos.title: Tulsi Accompanies Sejal
videos.overview: Savita asks Tulsi to accompany Sejal during her dance performance as a part of her sinister move. Will Tulsi be able to handle the responsibility?

videos.title: Suhasi Adopts a Child
videos.overview: Suhasi decides to adopt a child without any consent from her husband and family. While everyone is upset about her decision, Suhasi's husband supports her.

videos.title: The Viranis are Grateful
videos.overview: The Viranis are grateful to the audience for watching the serial, as it celebrates its second anniversary and recall the good old days. Govinda, Anu Mallik and the entire team of Star Plus celebrate the second anniversary of Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi.

videos.title: Baa Enjoys at School
videos.overview: Baa and her friends enjoy the company of each other at the school and have food together. Later, Suhashi's parents-in-law argue about the baby on the way.

videos.title: Shobha Makes a Request
videos.overview: Mihir tells Tulsi that he will give the property to Gautam after he completes his five years of marriage. On getting a letter from a stranger, Shobha requests Vishal to abruptly end their honeymoon.

videos.title: Sejal's Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: As Tulsi complains about Savita not assigning any work to Mihir, he tries to calm her down. Later, Jamnadas discusses Sejal�s marriage proposal with Gayatri.

videos.title: Suhasi to be a Foster Mother
videos.overview: When Suhasi asks Rakesh about Aniket's mother, he opens up with his history about the baby and Monisha. Elsewhere, Anand requests Rajeev for a loan for his wedding with Sejal.

videos.title: Daksha Gets Fooled
videos.overview: Amba gets excited as her design gets selected for India�s fashion week. As Daksha serves food hastily to Amba�s friends, Amba and Tulsi make fun of her.

videos.title: Jamnadas Supports Sejal
videos.overview: When Sejal tells about her boyfriend to Jamnadas, he stands by her. Elsewhere, Tulsi supports Suhasi as she adopts her husband�s child.

videos.title: Savita Cospires Against Tulsi
videos.overview: Savita tells Tulsi to leave the house and conspires against her with Mihir. When Rajeev shows his wedding card to Pooja, she gets worried about the name on the card.

videos.title: Gautam, Teesha Fall in Love
videos.overview: As Gautam and Teesha fall in love, Mansukh and Himmat talk to Gautam about his marriage with Ganga. Later, Payal warns her husband not to interfere in her matters.

videos.title: Aarti Creates Misunderstandings
videos.overview: As Gautam tells Aarti that he wants to marry Teesha, Aarti gets delighted thinking that her plan is working. Further, Aarti creates misunderstandings between Gautam and Tulsi.

videos.overview: Payal tells Vishal she has to go to Mumbai and gives the house keys to Shobha. As Aarti blackmails Teesha, Payal provokes Gautam to marry Ganga.

videos.overview: Gautam misunderstands Tulsi and agrees to marry Ganga to take revenge. As Payal plays tricks against Shobha and troubles her, Pratap protects her from Payal.

videos.title: Karishma at Virani House
videos.overview: As Harsh is caught doing drugs and debarred from school, he blames Karishma. Later, Tulsi, Jamnadas and Harsh take Karishma to the Virani house.

videos.title: Tulsi Invites Teesha

videos.title: Gautam Invites Aarti
videos.overview: The Viranis get busy with the wedding arrangements, and Gautam spends time with Teesha. While he invites Aarti, Tulsi asks him not to invite her to their house.

videos.title: Payal Invites Aarti
videos.overview: Payal restricts Shobha from attending Gautam's marriage. Although Gautam wants Aarti to attend his marriag, the Viranis oppose it. Meanwhile, Payal arrives for the function and invites Aarti to the rituals.

videos.title: Mihir Expresses His Disapproval
videos.overview: As Tulsi slips and falls down, Savita complains to Mihir that Tulsi does not take care of her health. Mihir tells Tulsi that he is not interested in knowing what happens between Tulsi and Savita.

videos.title: Gautam Dances with Teesha
videos.overview: As the Viranis organise a garba dance, Gautam drinks and dances with Teesha, shocking everyone. Meanwhile, Kabir and Kamya explore the Virani's house and talk about making their position in the Virani industry.

videos.title: Shobha Attends Gautam's Wedding
videos.overview: Teesha misunderstands Tulsi and tries to instigate Gautam against her. When Shobha calls up Gautam, he insists she attends his marriage, and Shobha attends Gautam's wedding.

videos.title: Teesha Gets Disappointed
videos.overview: Teesha cries on seeing Gautam and Ganga together in their wedding. Payal and Aarti discuss Gautam and Teesha's relationship. Tulsi and Jamnadas are concerned about Karishma's health.

videos.title: Anand, Sejal's Big Day!
videos.overview: The Viranis enjoy Anand and Sejal's marriage, but Jamnadas get angry with Sejal. Later, Rajeev attends the marriage, and introduces himself as Pooja's husband.

videos.title: Gautam, Teesha Spend Time
videos.overview: Gautam asks Ganga to take Tulsi's signature on a cheque book, and later meets Teesha at a restaurant.Laer, Gautam feels Teesha's presence around Ganga.

videos.title: Kamya, Kabir's Plot
videos.overview: Savita objects to giving the house keys to Ganga. Meanwhile, Anupam appreciates the business proposal of Kamya and Kabir, who are plotting against Mihir's business.

videos.title: Ganga Finds Out the Truth
videos.overview: As Teesha goes to Bangalore to try to get a loan, Ganga notices that Gautam and Teesha's rings are similar. She realises that Gautam lied to her about meeting Anupam in Bangalore.

videos.title: Worrying News for Mihir
videos.overview: While Daksha has a nightmare about Chirag, Prajakta and Chirag get worried about their future. Later, Mihir receives worrying news about his business.

videos.title: Tulsi's Request to Mansukhbhai
videos.overview: Tulsi asks Mansukhbhai to convince Savita to attend the inauguration of Amba Bhavan, but Savita refuses to come. Later, Savita makes a plan against Tulsi.

videos.title: Tulsi's Baby Shower Ceremony
videos.overview: As her due date approaches, the Viranis arranges a baby shower ceremony for Tulsi. Later, Hemant gets a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Pooja, Hemant's Confrontation
videos.overview: Hemant confronts Pooja and accuses her of playing with his emotions by giving him false hopes. Later, Tulsi tries to sweet talk Daksha.

videos.title: Sejal Narrates Her Woes
videos.overview: Sejal discloses that living life after marriage has been difficult for her due to her in laws' financial conditions. Later, Mihir invites the Gandhis for the inauguration.

videos.title: Hemant Invites Puja

videos.title: A Tiff between Savita, Daksha

videos.title: Mihir Worries for Hemant

videos.overview: Payal meets Tulsi with a devious intention after Mihir and Tulsi visit the temple. Hemant's father later cautions him to keep out of Sejal's life for her good.

videos.title: Sejal Disputes with Anand

videos.title: Savita, Daksha Sort Out Their Conflicts
videos.overview: Tulsi becomes concerned after Mihir fails to respond to her phone calls since he left. Later, Savita and Daksha sort out their disagreements.

videos.title: A Shocker for the Viranis!
videos.overview: Jamnadas receives a phone call regarding an accident after everyone becomes concerned about Mihir. Later, the Viranis arrive at the accident site.

videos.overview: Jamnadas, heartbroken, notifies Mansukh that Mihir is no longer alive. Later, Amba tries to notify Savita of Mihir's unfortunate demise.

videos.overview: Samaira shares her fears about Nandini and Karan's separation with Hrithik. Later, joy fills the air as the family gathers to celebrate Hrithik and Munni's Mehndi ceremony.

videos.title: Karan Triggers Gautam's Anger
videos.overview: Old grudges resurface when Gautam and Karan cross paths. Watching Karan and Nandini perform the Pooja, an upset Gautam lashes out at Tulsi for inviting him and Damini.

videos.title: Samaira's Emotional Struggle
videos.overview: Hrithik rescues Samaira as she attempts to harm herself. Then she opens up to the family about how Karan and Nandini's constant fighting caused her to take a drastic step.

videos.title: Hrithik, Munni's Sangeet
videos.overview: The Viranis enjoy a dance challenge at Hrithik and Munni's Sangeet. Tulsi and Mihir worry about the family rift, while Samaira tells Tulsi about Nandini and Karan's promise to her.

videos.title: Mihir's Dance for Tulsi
videos.overview: Mihir dances for Tulsi at the Sangeet, expressing his love. Joy fills the family as Hrithik and Munni exchange garlands, marking the beginning of their wedding rituals.

videos.title: Munni, Hrithik Tie the Knot
videos.overview: Happiness spreads as Hrithik and Munni get married and seek the family's blessings. Soon after, Mihir assures Tulsi that he will uphold Munni's respect in the Virani household.

videos.title: Gautam's Humble Request
videos.overview: The Virani family worries about Karan and Nandini's relationship. Gautam requests Tulsi to return to Shanti Niketan for the well-being of the Viranis.

videos.title: Tulsi Returns Home!
videos.overview: At Gautam's request, Tulsi returns to Shanti Niketan, recalling memories. Mihir is proud of Gautam for reuniting the family.

videos.title: Tearful Moment for Vrinda, Angad
videos.overview: Angad plans to covert as a worker at the Jamshedpur plant to uncover the cause of its losses. Then he and Vrinda feel emotional leaving Madhavi and Akshay at boarding school.

videos.title: Tulsi Stands Up for Munni
videos.overview: Tulsi firmly takes a stand for Munni when a guest tries to humiliate her by calling her a maid. Soon after, Mangal hits Angad for stopping him from misbehaving with Bharati.

videos.title: Munni Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Munni apologises to Hrithik, and they promise to be honest in their relationship. Mihir urges Gautam to return to Shanti Niketan with Damini, hinting at a new turn.

videos.title: Angad Crosses the Line
videos.overview: Angad takes a shocking step to win the workers' trust by hurting Vrinda. His actions spark outrage, while tensions rise across families and relationships.

videos.title: Ajay's Heartfelt Confession
videos.overview: Ajay confesses his love to Pari and expresses his desire to start a family with her. Hrithik confronts Mitali for taking Timsi with her without his consent.

videos.title: Nakul's Faith in Gautam
videos.overview: Nakul feels remorse and apologises to Gautam for his mistakes, yet remains confident that Gautam will get him out of jail. Damini reveals the truth in court.

videos.title: Hrithik's Appeal to Gautam
videos.overview: The Virani family is shocked by Mitali's legal notice for Timsi's custody. Gautam assures Nakul of his support as Hrithik calls Gautam for help.

videos.title: Noina Relives Old Memories
videos.overview: Noina visits the Virani office, growing emotional as she recalls moments with Mihir. Elsewhere, Angad sneaks into Vrinda's room, and they share a romantic moment.

videos.title: Gautam Unfolds Mitali's Secrets
videos.overview: Noina's refusal sparks conflict as Mihir, Gayatri, and Suchitra react while Gautam takes charge in court and proves Mitali wrong. Amid this, Bharati confesses her love to Angad.

videos.title: Tulsi's Pleasant Surprise
videos.overview: The court grants Timsi's custody to Hrithik, who thanks Gautam for the win. Tulsi is left stunned as Gautam, Damini, and Nakul plan a surprise return to Shanti Niketan.

videos.title: Noina's Last Wish
videos.overview: Tulsi informs Mihir about Noina's cancer and her wish to marry him, but Mihir refuses. Angad and Vrinda seek to identify who is behind the factory scam.

videos.title: Tulsi Gets Noina Home
videos.overview: Noina's return to Shanti Niketan sparks tension and hidden truths within the family. Angad's secret romance and Bharati's suspicions unravel alongside painful memories.

videos.title: Bharati Confronts Angad
videos.overview: Timsi pays no attention to Mitali, while Hrithik feels grateful to Munni for prioritising the family over herself. Bharati questions Angad about his relationship with Vrinda.

videos.title: Noina, Mihir's Sangeet Breaks Tulsi
videos.overview: The Virani family begins Mihir and Noina's Sangeet, leaving Tulsi heartbroken. Elsewhere, Bharati grows suspicious and follows Angad to Vrinda's house.

videos.title: Tulsi Fulfills Noina's Wish
videos.overview: Noina asks Tulsi to take responsibility for her marriage to Mihir. Tulsi agrees to perform the Ghatbandhan ritual, honoring Noina's heartfelt request.

videos.title: Noina's Lie Sparks New Trouble
videos.overview: Noina hides her truth as a mystery caller blackmails her. Meanwhile, Bharati confesses her love to Angad, leaving him emotionally conflicted.

videos.title: Angad's Tough Decision
videos.overview: A blackmailer demands half of Noina's property to keep her secret safe. Meanwhile, Angad agrees to marry Bharati under her father's pressure.

videos.title: Mihir Worries about Tulsi
videos.overview: Tension escalates as Tulsi goes missing from Shanti Niketan, forcing Mihir to halt his wedding with Noina. Elsewhere, Angad tries to explain to Bharati that he cannot marry her.

videos.title: Secrets Unfold as Tulsi Disappears
videos.overview: As Tulsi goes missing, Mihir's family spirals into panic while hidden motives and secrets begin to surface. Angad worries about Bharati's growing love for him.

videos.title: Angad Faces Workers' Wrath
videos.overview: Suchitra's return raises questions as Noina lies to hide the truth. The workers refuse to sign the MOU and demand a bonus. They wrongly assume that Angad supports the management.

videos.title: Secrets Rise as Tulsi Takes Charge
videos.overview: Suchitra spills on the blackmailer as Tulsi returns and reignites the halted wedding. But Noina's chilling act and hidden medicines spark a dark suspicion Tulsi can't ignore.

videos.title: Tulsi Doubts Noina
videos.overview: Tulsi is moved by Noina's emotional story, but suspicion resurfaces when Munni overhears a secret call about hidden reports. Tulsi finds two reports in Noina's room.

videos.title: Noina's Deception Play
videos.overview: Noina fears exposure as Tulsi takes her reports. Noina fakes worsening health to speed up her wedding. Tulsi urges Karan to delay the wedding until she verifies the reports.

videos.title: Tulsi Crashes the Wedding
videos.overview: Noina feels relieved on learning that the doctor is unavailable to review her reports that Tulsi took. Tulsi arrives just in time to halt Noina and Mihir's wedding.

videos.title: Noina's Truth Comes to Light
videos.overview: Tensions rise in the Virani family as Tulsi exposes Noina's fake illness. Soon after, she expels Noina from Shanti Niketan, warning her to stay away from the family.

videos.title: Tulsi's Request for Gautam's Return
videos.overview: As Tulsi regrets trusting Noina, the Virani family comforts her and stands by her. Soon after, she urges Gautam to return to Shanti Niketan with Damini and Nakul.

videos.title: Karan, Nandini Drift Apart
videos.overview: Mihir plans a romantic evening with Tulsi, while Munni and Shobha bring a hidden agenda. As secrets slip and tensions rise, Karan and Nandini's bond faces a fiery test.

videos.title: Munni Earns Prestigious Nomination
videos.overview: Shobha speaks with Gautam in an effort to persuade Tulsi to remarry Mihir. Meanwhile, Karan and Mihir praise Munni as she reveals her nomination for a prestigious award.

videos.title: Nandini's Doubts Grow
videos.overview: Pari reunites with her childhood friend Aryan, while Karan shares his plan of buying a house. A call from a bakery about an anniversary cake sparks suspicion in Nandini's mind.

videos.title: What Secret Is Karan Hiding?
videos.overview: Aryan and Pari open up about their past relationship and marriage. Tulsi notices Nandini secretly following Karan, while Nandini hopes to uncover Karan's hidden truth.

videos.title: Nandini Shares the Truth
videos.overview: Munni wins the Dynamic Personality of the Year award and credits Tulsi for her success. Nandini reveals to Tulsi that Karan is having an extramarital affair.

videos.title: Tulsi Confronts Karan
videos.overview: Nandini reveals Karan's alleged affair to Tulsi, leaving Mihir stunned. As Tulsi questions Karan, he denies the accusations, creating confusion and tension.

videos.title: Munni's Big Win Celebrations Begin
videos.overview: Tulsi visits Malabar Hills, where Karan hides the truth by using Madhu and Danny to mislead her. The Viranis celebrate Munni's win of the Dynamic Personality of the Year award.

videos.title: Gautam Unfolds Karan's Secret
videos.overview: Despite Tulsi's faith, Karan faces humiliation, but secrets unfold when Gautam shares proof against him. Pari's mistake with Sunny's medicine triggers panic and fury in the family.

videos.title: Nandini Reassures Tulsi
videos.overview: Gautam tells Tulsi that only Karan can reveal the truth. Nandini assures Tulsi that she is the same woman she saw with Karan in the picture.

videos.title: Pari's Advice to Ajay
videos.overview: Tulsi remembers Karan's broken promise. Gautam proposes a match between Pari and Aryan. Meanwhile, Pari urges Ajay to move on from their relationship.

videos.title: Tulsi Unveils the Truth
videos.overview: Tulsi's revelation of Karan's affair leaves Mihir shattered. At the same time, Saloni passionately teaches Dev that respect in life must be earned through hard work.

videos.title: Tulsi Faces a Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Tulsi confronts Karan over his alleged affair, but Rio intervenes, leaving her stunned. As Karan hides the truth about their relationship, Tulsi questions him further.

videos.title: Karan's Ultimate Revelation
videos.overview: Karan reveals to Tulsi that Rio, aka Riyansh, is Ansh and Niyati's son. He explains meeting Niyati in America and how she and Rio became an important part of his life.

videos.title: Tulsi Feels Guilty
videos.overview: Tulsi feels guilty for misunderstanding Karan. To avoid breaking Nandini's trust, Tulsi urges him to reveal Rio's truth, while Rio plans to reunite with his family.

videos.title: Nandini Learns about Rio
videos.overview: The Viranis plan Tulsi and Mihir's wedding, while Nandini's painful past is triggered after learning about Rio. Parth and Vaishnavi open up about their love for each other.

videos.title: Karan Reassures Nandini
videos.overview: Everyone wants Mihir and Tulsi to marry, and Gautam introduces Aryan to Tulsi as a potential match for Pari. Karan assures Nandini that Niyati and Rio won't affect their family.

videos.title: Dev, Shaloni at Odds
videos.overview: Dev and Shaloni clash over making decisions, while Ajay worries about Pari and shares his concern with Sandhya. Hrithik and Munni's car breaks down, and Rio gives them a lift.

videos.title: A Shocker for Nandini
videos.overview: The Viranis head out for a family dinner, unaware that Rio has booked the same restaurant. As light moments unfold, tensions rise when Nandini spots Niyati in the washroom.

videos.title: Tulsi Opposes the Wedding
videos.overview: Nandini is shocked to see Rio and recalls her past with Ansh. As everyone waits for Tulsi at dinner, Tulsi refuses to marry Mihir, and Pari calls off her wedding to Aryan.

videos.title: An Emotional Moment for Tulsi
videos.overview: Tulsi shares her life tensions, sensing the presence and guidance of her late mother-in-law. The Viranis get excited as Tulsi agrees to remarry Mihir.

videos.title: Rio Suspects Karan
videos.overview: Mihir and Tulsi opt for a simple temple wedding. Meanwhile, Nandini joins Karan for shopping, and Rio spots them together, growing suspicious of a possible affair.

videos.title: Karan Reveals the Truth to Rio
videos.overview: Tulsi and Mihir's children bring outfits for their wedding. Rio questions Karan about his relationship with Nandini, prompting Karan to reveal the truth about his past and Ansh.

videos.title: Rio Searches for Answers
videos.overview: As the family prepares for Tulsi's and Mihir's wedding, Rio is left shattered after learning a painful truth from Karan. Determined to uncover the truth, he confronts Karan.

videos.title: Ranvijay Kidnaps Sunny
videos.overview: Tulsi's and Mihir's wedding celebrations begin as they follow the rituals. But happiness turns into panic when Ranvijay's men mistakenly kidnap Sunny instead of Garima.

videos.title: Tulsi, Mihir Begin a New Journey
videos.overview: As Tulsi and Mihir begin their married life, Pari is left shaken after Ranvijay's death. While Ajay comforts her, the family warmly welcomes the newlyweds home.

videos.title: Mihir Leaves for the US
videos.overview: Karan informs Mihir and Tulsi that he disclosed the truth to Rio after obtaining the evidence. Mihir leaves for the US to handle a factory fire, asking Karan to protect Rio.

videos.title: Pari Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Pari's arrest shocks everyone as Sunny reveals the truth to the police, while Gautam promises to help her. Meanwhile, Rio reaches Shanti Niketan to confront Karan about his family.

videos.title: Pari Is Acquitted
videos.overview: Ajay fights strongly for Pari in court as Suhas and Indira speak in her support. After hearing the full incident, justice prevails as Pari is honourably acquitted.

videos.title: Munni and Saloni Share Big News
videos.overview: Excitement fills Shanti Niketan as Aryan's parents arrive to fix his wedding with Pari and request an early marriage. Amid celebrations, Munni and Saloni reveal their pregnancies.

videos.title: Tulsi Remembers Ansh
videos.overview: Tulsi becomes emotional on Ansh's death anniversary and asks Karan to make a donation in his memory. Meanwhile, Ajay struggles to come to terms with Pari's marriage to Aryan.

videos.title: Rio Senses a Hidden Secret
videos.overview: As Rio researches Ansh's plane crash incident, he discovers that Ansh was not on the flight. Soon after, Indira consoles a heartbroken Ajay over Pari's engagement to Aryan.

videos.title: Pari and Aryan Get Engaged
videos.overview: Celebrations begin as Pari and Aryan exchange rings, while Ajay struggles emotionally after meeting Pari. Rio shocks Karan with proof that Ansh did not die in a plane crash.

videos.title: Ajay's Heartfelt Blessings
videos.overview: Tulsi urges Pari and Aryan to seek Lord Krishna's blessings before exchanging garlands. Ajay believes they are a perfect match and considers them lucky to be getting married.

videos.title: Pari's Unexpected Wedding Surprise
videos.overview: Nandini informs Karan about Rio's visit, as Rio is seeking the truth about Ansh. Pari's eyes light up in joy as Ajay arrives as her groom, creating a heartfelt moment.

videos.title: Ansh's Shadow in Nandini's Dream
videos.overview: The Viranis are filled with joy over Ajay and Pari's marriage, while Tulsi misses Mihir. Soon, Nandini is left terrified after a disturbing dream in which Ansh scares her.

videos.title: Tulsi's Move Stuns Nandini
videos.overview: Karan updates Tulsi about Niyati's panic attacks and Rio's attempt to uncover the truth. Later, Tulsi's proposal to bring Niyati and Rio to Shantiniketan leaves Nandini stunned.

videos.title: Tulsi's Decision Shocks Nandini
videos.overview: Nandini is stunned and asks Tulsi to choose between her and Rio when she expresses her wish to bring him home. Meanwhile, Rio discovers Ansh's old photographs in the storeroom.

videos.title: Tulsi Reveals the Truth
videos.overview: Rio uncovers the truth about Ansh and questions Tulsi for eliminating him. The family is left stunned as Tulsi reveals the dark side of Ansh that justified her actions.

videos.title: Rio Condemns Tulsi
videos.overview: Rio blames Tulsi for killing Ansh is wrong. The doctor insists that Karan and Rio let Niyati stay with the family to support her recovery. Will Rio stay with the Viranis?

videos.title: Karan, Niyati's Bond Upsets Nandini
videos.overview: Nandini feels hurt seeing Karan and Niyati's closeness and confronts him. Tulsi then informs the men of the family that they must go to Delhi regarding the property division.

videos.title: Rio-Nandini's Confrontation!
videos.overview: Dev clashes with the family as Parth gains more property. While Parth and Vaishnavi celebrate a bulk order, Rio dredges up the past and blames Nandini for Ansh's death.

videos.title: Tulsi and Nandini at Odds
videos.overview: The men of the Virani family prepare to leave for Delhi. Niyati's words upset Nandini, further sparking tensions between Nandini and Tulsi.

videos.title: Khushboo Accuses Rio!
videos.overview: Fear grips the Virani family as Khushboo faces an exploitation attempt. Police begin investigating, and Khushboo shocks everyone by accusing Rio of the act.

videos.title: Rio Faces Arrest
videos.overview: As Rio is taken into custody, Niyati confronts Tulsi and the family for not believing him. The police assault Rio, accusing him of exploiting Khushboo, but he denies the charges.

videos.title: Tulsi Exposes Khushboo's Lie
videos.overview: Tulsi doubts the accusations against Rio as she suspects Khushboo. Later, she exposes Khushboo, who finally confesses the truth, proving Rio innocent.

videos.title: Rio Wins the Family's Trust
videos.overview: Tulsi apologises to Rio and convinces him to stay, promising her unwavering support. While Rio secures Khushboo's bail and earns the family's trust, he secretly plots against them.

videos.title: Niyati Learns Karan's Truth
videos.overview: Parth was about to loose a business deal because of Rio, but later the client unexpectedly agreed to it. Niyati is left shocked after learning the truth about Karan's wedding.

videos.title: Tulsi and Nandini's Clash Explodes
videos.overview: After Niyati is taken to the hospital, Rio blames Tulsi for the accident, sparking a clash between Tulsi and Nandini. Nandini decides to leave the house, and Munni stops her.

videos.title: Niyati Recovers Her Memory
videos.overview: Niyati regains her memory and confronts Tulsi over Ansh's death. As tensions rise at Shantiniketan over Niyati and Rio's stay, Parth grows suspicious of Rio's intentions.

videos.title: Tulsi Stands Firm for Rio
videos.overview: Rio persuades Niyati to return to Shantiniketan following her discharge. Tulsi's warm welcome and her pledge to protect Rio's rights create tension within the family.

videos.title: Nandini, Damini Get New Duties
videos.overview: Rio steps in to protect Parth after he is beaten by goons while rescuing Vaishnavi. At home, Tulsi wisely shares house responsibilities between Nandini and Damini.

videos.title: Tulsi's Challenge for Rio, Parth
videos.overview: Tulsi announces a decisive task that will determine who receives the business's Power of Attorney. As Rio and Parth battle it out, a clever strategy steals the spotlight.

videos.title: Parth Fumes at Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Rio's clever move secures the Power of Attorney, leaving Parth upset. Later, Parth grows jealous when Vaishnavi praises Rio and vents his anger at her.

videos.title: Parth's Special Plan for Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Parth decorates the house for a grand proposal to Vaishnavi on her birthday. Elsewhere, Vaishnavi tells Rio that she is hurt that no one wished her, and he orders a cake for her.

videos.title: Parth, Vaishnavi's Rift Deepens
videos.overview: Parth loses his temper after seeing Vaishnavi cutting the cake with Rio, and Tulsi tries to calm them. Nandini accuses Tulsi of constantly being biased and supporting Rio.

videos.title: Parth Turns to Tulsi
videos.overview: Tulsi helps Vaishnavi understand Parth's efforts and love, while he opens up about his pain. As Karan returns, Nandini mocks Niyati and credits Karan for the business's success.

videos.title: Damini and Gautam Walk Away
videos.overview: Nandini's words wound Gautam's pride, sparking tension in the Virani family. Feeling disrespected, Gautam and Damini decide to leave Shantiniketan.

videos.title: Nandini Advises Parth
videos.overview: Nandini asks Parth to plan a grand proposal and engagement for Vaishnavi. Nandini then clashes with Damini, blaming her as they argue over Karan taking charge of the business.

videos.title: Karan, Gautam at Odds
videos.overview: Parth announces his engagement to Vaishnavi, delighting the family. But the joy is interrupted as Tulsi reprimands Gautam and Karan for clashing over household expenses.

videos.title: Parth, Vaishnavi Exchange Rings
videos.overview: Parth is stunned when clients praise his designs under Rio's name. Parth and Vaishnavi exchange rings and reaffirm their love, after which the family gathers for a group photo.

videos.title: Rio Creates Trouble for Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Parth grows upset over Rio's closeness with Vaishnavi. Soon, he confronts Vaishnavi over the texts and pictures she sent to Nakul, unaware that Rio is behind it.

videos.title: Parth Accuses Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Parth fumes in anger and questions Vaishnavi's character after seeing her with Rio. Tulsi slaps Parth for doubting Vaishnavi's loyalty, sparking a fierce family conflict.

videos.title: Tulsi Stands by Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Amid family conflicts and broken bonds, Tulsi seeks strength, remembering Savita. After a while, she consoles Vaishnavi, who shatters over the rumours degrading her character.

videos.title: A Shocking Move by Rio, Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Rio shocks Tulsi by proposing to Vaishnavi to save her from public humiliation. Then, a major conflict erupts in the Virani family over Rio and Vaishnavi's decision.

videos.title: Rio, Vaishnavi Get Engaged
videos.overview: Nandini and Damini get into a heated confrontation that ends with slaps exchanged between them. Amid the chaos, Rio and Vaishnavi move forward with their engagement ceremony.

videos.title: Parth's Heartbreak Over Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Parth feels broken watching Vaishnavi and Rio together. Soon, Nandini confronts Vaishnavi, accusing her of being opportunistic and greedy, but Vaishnavi stands up for herself.

videos.title: Karan Hands His Property to Parth
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Karan and Gautam clash over Nandini and Damini's dispute. Later, Karan hands over the power of attorney for his property to Parth.

videos.title: Parth, Rio Join Forces
videos.overview: Rio steps aside and lets Parth marry Vaishnavi. After their wedding, Parth and Rio celebrate securing Karan's power of attorney and plan to sell the heritage property.

videos.title: Vaishnavi Discovers the Truth
videos.overview: Parth meets a client to sale Shanti Niketan, while Tulsi discovers that he has returned home drunk. Vaishnavi follows Parth and is shocked to learn about him selling the house.

videos.title: Tulsi Confronts Parth
videos.overview: Vaishnavi tells Tulsi that Parth is selling the family's ancestral property. Witnessing Parth's aggressive behaviour, Tulsi steps in just as he is about to hurt Vaishnavi.

videos.title: Tulsi Suspects Parth's Intentions
videos.overview: Parth silences Vaishnavi to keep his secrets hidden from the family. As Tulsi grows wary of his behaviour, he takes Vaishnavi to Khandala, deepening her suspicions

videos.title: Parth Crosses All Limits
videos.overview: Parth lashes out at Vaishnavi for burning the agreement papers, and his behaviour spirals out of control. Tulsi rushes in and is forced to fight back to save Vaishnavi.

videos.title: Parth's Deadly Betrayal
videos.overview: Tulsi asks Rio to take Vaishnavi to the police station, but he takes her to meet Parth. However, Parth pushes Vaishnavi off a cliff and frames Rio for the crime.

videos.title: Nandini's Fierce Move against Parth
videos.overview: Seeing Parth's cruelty towards Vaishnavi, Nandini confronts him in rage. With no option left, Nandini takes a shocking step against Parth, triggering flashes of a haunted past.

videos.title: Tulsi Surrenders to the Police
videos.overview: Tulsi takes the blame and turns herself in to the police for Parth's death. Karan carries out the funeral rites of Rio and Parth as the Virani family mourns in pain.

videos.title: Nandini Hides Parth's Truth
videos.overview: Karan demands answers from Vaishnavi about why Tulsi shot Parth. As Vaishnavi leaves the house, Nandini insists that she conceal the truth about Parth's death.

videos.title: Mihir's Letter Breaks Tulsi
videos.overview: Karan fumes at Tulsi for killing Ansh, Rio, and Parth. Nandini breaks down, bound by Tulsi's promise, while Tulsi receives Mihir's letter saying he never wants to see her again.

videos.title: Vaishnavi Confides in Aarti
videos.overview: Vaishnavi breaks down as she reveals Parth's truth to Aarti before seeking Tulsi's guidance in jail. Gayatri steps up to take responsibility for Shanti Niketan.

videos.title: Divine Light Brings Hope to Tulsi
videos.overview: Tulsi breaks down while reflecting on her life and seeking salvation. Lord Krishna appears and guides her, giving her strength to live and leading her toward righteousness.

videos.title: Tulsi Returns to Shantiniketan
videos.overview: Nandini firmly refuses to leave Shantiniketan despite Karan's insistence. Ten years later, Tulsi gets released from jail and arrives at Shantiniketan, where her memories resurface.

videos.title: Karan, Gautam's Rivalry Stuns Tulsi
videos.overview: Disguised as a waitress, Tulsi secretly enters Shanti Niketan and is stunned by the partition of the house. Later, Karan and Gautam's bitter rivalry escalates into open conflict.

videos.title: Gautam's Bold Challenge
videos.overview: Karan tells Nandini he does not accept Tulsi as his mother and will not allow her into Shanti Niketan. Gautam vows to fight for his rights, believing Tulsi will support him.

videos.title: Tulsi Misses Mihir
videos.overview: As Tulsi arrives at Shanti Niketan, she learns Mihir never returned home and recalls their memories. Hrithik is disturbed to see the house divided by Gautam and Karan's rift.

videos.title: Karan Accuses Tulsi
videos.overview: Tulsi confides in Vaishnavi that she won't leave Shanti Niketan until things improve. Later, Karan, torn by grief, tells Nandini that he holds Tulsi responsible for losing Parth.

videos.title: Shobha Expresses Faith in Tulsi
videos.overview: Nandini is lost in thoughts about Tulsi's sacrifice, while Shobha insists Tulsi never does anything wrong. Karan feels proud of Raunak, Samaira, and Garima for their hard work.

videos.title: Tulsi Confronts Nandini
videos.overview: Tulsi questions Nandini about the rift between Shanti Niketan and the broken Virani family. Meanwhile, Nakul tells Gautam that their hotel at Amba Nivas has been shut down.

videos.title: Tulsi's Comeback to Shanti Niketan
videos.overview: Tulsi arrives at Shanti Niketan, claiming to be its rightful owner. She then confronts and slaps Gautam for selling Amba Nivas and turning it into a hotel.

videos.title: Tulsi's Law at Shanti Niketan
videos.overview: Tulsi demands everyone pay rent at Shanti Niketan and enforces her rules. She then removes the separation line, uniting the household for a hopeful new beginning.

videos.title: Shobha Decodes Tulsi's Move
videos.overview: Karan and Gautam hold each other responsible for the house's partition and Tulsi's demand. Shobha and Gayatri realise that Tulsi's move is a clever attempt to unite the brothers.

videos.title: Tulsi Learns Vaishnavi's Secret
videos.overview: Tulsi is stunned to learn about Vaishnavi's relationship with Nakul and questions her for hiding the truth. Meanwhile, Garima's behaviour sparks fresh tensions at home.

videos.title: Tulsi Supports Nakul's Love
videos.overview: Nakul openly confesses his love for Vaishnavi, but Gautam refuses to accept their relationship. As Tulsi stands by them, Karan's anger sparks fresh conflict at Shanti Niketan.

videos.title: Karan Humiliates Vaishnavi
videos.overview: Gautam agrees to Nakul and Vaishnavi's marriage, but Karan strongly opposes it. After publicly insulting Vaishnavi, he faces Tulsi's anger as Vaishnavi leaves home.

videos.title: Tulsi Brings Vaishnavi Back Home
videos.overview: Tulsi stops Vaishnavi from leaving and brings her back home despite Karan's anger. Raunak and Samaira's pranks backfire as Tulsi cleverly turns the tables on them.

videos.title: Vaishnavi Helps Garima
videos.overview: The police take Garima and Krish to the police station after Garima fails to prove she is not a minor. Soon, Vaishnavi secures her release and takes her home.

videos.title: Nandini's Request to Gautam
videos.overview: Tension mounts as Karan discovers Raunak in jail, where the police reveal a fraud complaint has been filed against him. Nandini asks Gautam to help secure Raunak's bail.
